package answer

import (
	"context"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

const (
	courseContentStatusActive = 1

	blockingReasonLessonInactive     = "LESSON_INACTIVE"
	blockingReasonTaskInactive       = "TASK_INACTIVE"
	blockingReasonCompletePrevTask   = "COMPLETE_PREVIOUS_TASK"
	blockingReasonCompletePrevLesson = "COMPLETE_PREVIOUS_LESSON"
)

type TaskLockedError struct {
	TaskID           string
	RedirectLessonID string
	RedirectTaskID   string
}

func (e *TaskLockedError) Error() string {
	return domain.ErrTaskLocked.Error()
}

func (e *TaskLockedError) Unwrap() error {
	return domain.ErrTaskLocked
}

type CourseProgression struct {
	CourseID        string               `json:"course_id"`
	CurrentLessonID string               `json:"current_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	CurrentTaskID   string               `json:"current_task_id,omitempty"`
	CourseCompleted bool                 `json:"course_completed"`
	Lessons         []CourseLessonAccess `json:"lessons"`
}

type CourseLessonAccess struct {
	ID             string             `json:"id"`
	CourseID       string             `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Title          string             `json:"title"`
	Description    string             `json:"description"`
	Order          int                `json:"order"`
	Status         int                `json:"status"`
	Locked         bool               `json:"locked"`
	Completed      bool               `json:"completed"`
	Current        bool               `json:"current"`
	BlockingReason string             `json:"blocking_reason,omitempty"`
	Tasks          []CourseTaskAccess `json:"tasks"`
}

type CourseTaskAccess struct {
	ID              string `json:"id"`
	LessonID        string `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID        string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Title           string `json:"title"`
	Description     string `json:"description"`
	Type            int16  `json:"type"`
	TaskKind        string `json:"task_kind,omitempty"`
	Order           int    `json:"order"`
	Status          int    `json:"status"`
	EvaluationMode  string `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	Locked          bool   `json:"locked"`
	Completed       bool   `json:"completed"`
	Current         bool   `json:"current"`
	Readonly        bool   `json:"readonly"`
	EffectiveStatus string `json:"effective_status,omitempty"`
	LatestAnswerID  string `json:"latest_answer_id,omitempty"`
	BlockingReason  string `json:"blocking_reason,omitempty"`
}

type TaskAccess struct {
	TaskID           string `json:"task_id"`
	LessonID         string `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID         string `json:"course_id"`
	Locked           bool   `json:"locked"`
	Completed        bool   `json:"completed"`
	Current          bool   `json:"current"`
	Readonly         bool   `json:"readonly"`
	BlockingReason   string `json:"blocking_reason,omitempty"`
	RedirectLessonID string `json:"redirect_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	RedirectTaskID   string `json:"redirect_task_id,omitempty"`
}

type LessonAccess struct {
	LessonID         string `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID         string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Locked           bool   `json:"locked"`
	Completed        bool   `json:"completed"`
	Current          bool   `json:"current"`
	BlockingReason   string `json:"blocking_reason,omitempty"`
	RedirectLessonID string `json:"redirect_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	RedirectTaskID   string `json:"redirect_task_id,omitempty"`
}

type PracticeTaskScopedAccessResolver interface {
	ResolvePracticeTaskLessonAccess(ctx context.Context, userID, lessonID string) (*LessonAccess, error)
	ResolvePracticeTaskTaskAccess(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID string) (*TaskAccess, error)
}

// ProgressionService resolves student access through ordered lessons/tasks.
type ProgressionService struct {
	TaskProvider       TaskProvider
	Lessons            LessonProvider
	Answers            repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	PracticeTaskAccess PracticeTaskScopedAccessResolver
}

func (s ProgressionService) ResolveCourse(ctx context.Context, userID string, courseID string) (*CourseProgression, error) {
	if s.TaskProvider == nil || s.Answers == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	structure, err := s.TaskProvider.GetCourseStructure(ctx, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if structure.CourseID != "" {
		courseID = structure.CourseID
	}

	lessons := append([]CourseStructureLesson(nil), structure.Lessons...)

	taskIDs := make([]string, 0)
	for _, lesson := range lessons {
		for _, task := range lesson.Tasks {
			taskIDs = append(taskIDs, task.ID)
		}
	}
	progressMap, err := s.Answers.GetProgressByTaskIDs(ctx, userID, taskIDs)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := &CourseProgression{
		CourseID: courseID,
		Lessons:  make([]CourseLessonAccess, 0, len(lessons)),
	}

	currentAssigned := false
	for _, lesson := range lessons {
		tasks := append([]CourseStructureTask(nil), lesson.Tasks...)
		sort.SliceStable(tasks, func(i, j int) bool {
			if tasks[i].Order == tasks[j].Order {
				return tasks[i].ID < tasks[j].ID
			}
			return tasks[i].Order < tasks[j].Order
		})

		lessonResp := CourseLessonAccess{
			ID:          lesson.ID,
			CourseID:    lesson.CourseID,
			Title:       lesson.Title,
			Description: lesson.Description,
			Order:       lesson.Order,
			Status:      lesson.Status,
			Tasks:       make([]CourseTaskAccess, 0, len(tasks)),
		}

		lessonCompleted := true
		lessonCurrent := false
		firstIncompleteLocked := false
		firstIncompleteSeen := false

		for _, task := range tasks {
			item := CourseTaskAccess{
				ID:             task.ID,
				LessonID:       task.LessonID,
				CourseID:       task.CourseID,
				Title:          task.Title,
				Description:    task.Description,
				Type:           task.Type,
				TaskKind:       taskKindFromType(task.Type),
				Order:          task.Order,
				Status:         task.Status,
				EvaluationMode: strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(task.EvaluationMode)),
			}

			if lesson.Status != courseContentStatusActive {
				item.Locked = true
				item.BlockingReason = blockingReasonLessonInactive
				lessonResp.Tasks = append(lessonResp.Tasks, item)
				continue
			}
			if task.Status != courseContentStatusActive {
				item.Locked = true
				item.BlockingReason = blockingReasonTaskInactive
				lessonResp.Tasks = append(lessonResp.Tasks, item)
				continue
			}

			progress := progressMap[task.ID]
			item.EffectiveStatus = answerStatusName(progress.LatestStatus)
			item.LatestAnswerID = progress.LatestAnswerID
			item.Readonly = progress.HasPassed
			item.Completed = isProgressionTaskCompleted(item.EvaluationMode, progress)

			if item.Completed {
				lessonResp.Tasks = append(lessonResp.Tasks, item)
				continue
			}

			lessonCompleted = false
			if !firstIncompleteSeen {
				firstIncompleteSeen = true
			}

			if !currentAssigned {
				item.Current = true
				lessonCurrent = true
				currentAssigned = true
				result.CurrentLessonID = lesson.ID
				result.CurrentTaskID = task.ID
			} else {
				item.Locked = true
				if result.CurrentLessonID == lesson.ID {
					item.BlockingReason = blockingReasonCompletePrevTask
				} else {
					item.BlockingReason = blockingReasonCompletePrevLesson
				}
				if !firstIncompleteLocked {
					firstIncompleteLocked = true
				}
			}

			lessonResp.Tasks = append(lessonResp.Tasks, item)
		}

		lessonResp.Completed = lessonCompleted
		lessonResp.Current = lessonCurrent
		lessonResp.Locked = !lessonCompleted && !lessonCurrent && firstIncompleteLocked
		if lessonResp.Locked {
			if lessonResp.BlockingReason == "" && result.CurrentLessonID != "" {
				if result.CurrentLessonID == lesson.ID {
					lessonResp.BlockingReason = blockingReasonCompletePrevTask
				} else {
					lessonResp.BlockingReason = blockingReasonCompletePrevLesson
				}
			}
		}
		if lesson.Status != courseContentStatusActive {
			lessonResp.Locked = true
			lessonResp.Current = false
			lessonResp.Completed = false
			lessonResp.BlockingReason = blockingReasonLessonInactive
		}

		result.Lessons = append(result.Lessons, lessonResp)
	}

	result.CourseCompleted = result.CurrentTaskID == ""
	return result, nil
}

func (s ProgressionService) ResolveTaskAccess(ctx context.Context, userID string, taskID string) (*TaskAccess, error) {
	if _, ok := PracticeTaskScopeFromContext(ctx); ok && s.PracticeTaskAccess != nil {
		return s.PracticeTaskAccess.ResolvePracticeTaskTaskAccess(ctx, userID, taskID)
	}
	if s.TaskProvider == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	task, err := s.TaskProvider.GetTask(WithTaskLookupContext(ctx, userID, ""), taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	task = NormalizeTaskMetadata(task)
	if isPracticeTaskRuntimeTask(task) {
		return &TaskAccess{
			TaskID:           task.ID,
			LessonID:         task.LessonID,
			CourseID:         task.CourseID,
			Locked:           task.Locked,
			Completed:        task.Completed,
			Current:          !task.Locked,
			Readonly:         task.Readonly,
			BlockingReason:   task.BlockingReason,
			RedirectLessonID: task.RedirectLessonID,
			RedirectTaskID:   task.RedirectTaskID,
		}, nil
	}
	if relationID, publicRequest := PublicContentAccessFromContext(ctx); publicRequest && relationID != "" {
		if s.Answers == nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		progressMap, err := s.Answers.GetProgressByTaskIDs(ctx, userID, []string{task.ID})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		progress := progressMap[task.ID]
		completed := isProgressionTaskCompleted(task.EvaluationMode, progress)
		return &TaskAccess{
			TaskID:    task.ID,
			LessonID:  task.LessonID,
			CourseID:  task.CourseID,
			Completed: completed,
			Current:   !completed,
			Readonly:  progress.HasPassed,
		}, nil
	}
	progression, err := s.ResolveCourse(ctx, userID, task.CourseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	for _, lesson := range progression.Lessons {
		for _, item := range lesson.Tasks {
			if item.ID != taskID {
				continue
			}
			return &TaskAccess{
				TaskID:           item.ID,
				LessonID:         lesson.ID,
				CourseID:         progression.CourseID,
				Locked:           item.Locked,
				Completed:        item.Completed,
				Current:          item.Current,
				Readonly:         item.Readonly,
				BlockingReason:   item.BlockingReason,
				RedirectLessonID: progression.CurrentLessonID,
				RedirectTaskID:   progression.CurrentTaskID,
			}, nil
		}
	}

	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (s *ProgressionService) RequireTaskUnlocked(ctx context.Context, userID string, taskID string) error {
	if s == nil {
		return nil
	}
	access, err := s.ResolveTaskAccess(ctx, userID, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !access.Locked {
		return nil
	}
	return &TaskLockedError{
		TaskID:           taskID,
		RedirectLessonID: access.RedirectLessonID,
		RedirectTaskID:   access.RedirectTaskID,
	}
}

func (s ProgressionService) ResolveLessonAccess(ctx context.Context, userID string, lessonID string) (*LessonAccess, error) {
	if _, ok := PracticeTaskScopeFromContext(ctx); ok && s.PracticeTaskAccess != nil {
		return s.PracticeTaskAccess.ResolvePracticeTaskLessonAccess(ctx, userID, lessonID)
	}
	if s.Lessons == nil || s.TaskProvider == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	lesson, err := s.Lessons.GetLesson(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if relationID, publicRequest := PublicContentAccessFromContext(ctx); publicRequest && relationID != "" {
		return &LessonAccess{
			LessonID: lesson.ID,
			CourseID: lesson.CourseID,
			Current:  true,
		}, nil
	}
	progression, err := s.ResolveCourse(ctx, userID, lesson.CourseID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	for _, item := range progression.Lessons {
		if item.ID != lessonID {
			continue
		}
		return &LessonAccess{
			LessonID:         item.ID,
			CourseID:         item.CourseID,
			Locked:           item.Locked,
			Completed:        item.Completed,
			Current:          item.Current,
			BlockingReason:   item.BlockingReason,
			RedirectLessonID: progression.CurrentLessonID,
			RedirectTaskID:   progression.CurrentTaskID,
		}, nil
	}

	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func isProgressionTaskCompleted(evaluationMode string, progress domain.StudentTaskProgress) bool {
	if progress.HasPassed {
		return true
	}
	switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(evaluationMode)) {
	case taskEvaluationManual, taskEvaluationHybrid:
		return progress.HasUnderReview
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func answerStatusName(status int) string {
	switch status {
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress:
		return "IN_PROGRESS"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview:
		return "UNDER_REVIEW"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed:
		return "FAILED"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusRejected:
		return "REJECTED"
	case domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed:
		return "PASSED"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}
